# Myles Away Travel

> Myles Away Travel is a personal, hands-on travel agency based in Royal Oak, Michigan. Myles Fiascone plans custom itineraries and complex multi-stop trips one-on-one, and specializes in complex logistics, finding great deals, and hands-off travel planning. Myles is a certified Hawai'i Destination Expert and the agency is hosted through WorldVia Travel Network.

## Key facts

- Business: Myles Away Travel (travel agency / travel agent)
- Location: Royal Oak, Michigan, USA (Metro Detroit, Oakland County)
- Also serves: Birmingham, Ferndale, Troy, Berkley, Clawson, Madison Heights and Detroit
- Travel agent: Myles Fiascone
- Credential: Hawai'i Destination Expert (certified)
- Host agency: WorldVia Travel Network
- Phone: +1 847-624-0998
- Email: 2travelmylesaway@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/myles.away.travel/
- Website: https://mylesaway-travel.com/
- Specialties: complex trip logistics, multi-destination itineraries, group travel, long international trips, finding deals
- Favorite destinations: Hawaii, Bora Bora and French Polynesia, Italy, New Zealand, Ireland, Portugal

## Services

- Essential Trip Planning: destination research plus lodging and flight recommendations for domestic trips, weekend getaways and straightforward travel needs.
- Custom Itinerary Planning: personalized daily itinerary with activity, dining and experience recommendations, plus budget guidance for international trips, multi-city travel or first-time destinations.
- Premium / Complex Trip Design: fully customized day-by-day itinerary, multiple destination coordination and logistics planning (transfers, timing, travel flow) for group travel, long international trips or high-touch experiences.
- Packages can be adjusted to each traveler's needs. Fees depend on the package and trip complexity.
